answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 156243 Country: India Title: Regarding keeping cold drink in the shop Question: I am opening a shop. My intention was to keep cold drink (eg Coca Cola, Sprite, Due etc.) in it but in a statement I heard that it is a Jewish company, it is both unfair to sell and use it. So my question was, what types of cold drinks can I keep in my shop? Please explain clearly. Answer ID: 156243 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 172/116/SD=2/1439) If there is no surety or presumption that some haram or impure thing is mixed in cold drinks then its business is not unlawful and haram. But if someone avoids such business on his own wish then there is no problem in it, rather it is better. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
